tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: 人先物後：give 人 物；物先人後：give 物 to 人、buy 物 for 人。

tips.label: Why 的用法
tips.text: 問原因用 Why；be 動詞放主詞前，一般動詞用 do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

tips.label: Because 和 So
tips.text: because 後接原因；so 後接結果。同一組因果子句不要同時用 because 和 so。

tips.label: Because 和 Because of
tips.text: because + 主詞 + 動詞；because of + 名詞或名詞片語。

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種句型
notes.rule: S + V + 人 + 物；S + V + 物 + to／for + 人
notes.description: give、send、show、write、pass 的物在前時用 to；buy、make、cook 用 for。人直接放在動詞後、物放最後時，不加介系詞。本課物用 it／them 時，採「物 + to／for + 人」。
examples: The doctor gave Ben some medicine.
The doctor gave some medicine to Ben.
Mom bought a coat for Amy.

notes.title: Why 的用法
notes.rule: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞 ...?；Why + do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?
notes.description: Why 問原因。問狀態時將 be 動詞放主詞前；問一般動詞的動作時用 do、does 或 did。did／did not 後面的動詞都用原形。回答可用 Because + 原因子句。
examples: Why does Tom wear a mask every day?
Why did you call the doctor?
Why didn't Amy take her medicine?

notes.title: Because 和 So 的因果順序
notes.rule: 結果 + because + 原因；Because + 原因, 結果；原因, so + 結果
notes.description: because 帶出原因，so 帶出結果。because 子句放句首時，後面用逗號分開。同一組因果子句不寫成 Because ..., so ...。
examples: I stayed home because I had a fever.
Because I had a fever, I stayed home.
I had a fever, so I stayed home.

notes.title: Because 和 Because of 的差別
notes.rule: because + 子句；because of + 名詞／名詞片語
notes.description: 先看後面有沒有主詞與動詞。he was sick 是完整子句，用 because；his illness 是名詞片語，用 because of。不能只看中文都譯為「因為」就混用。
examples: Tom missed school because he had a fever.
Tom missed school because of his fever.
Because the weather was bad, we stayed home.
Because of the bad weather, we stayed home.

quiz.question: The nurse gave a clean towel ___ the boy.
quiz.hint: give 的物在前、人在後時，用 give + 物 + to + 人。

quiz.question: My brother bought some oranges ___ our grandma.
quiz.hint: buy 表示替人買東西，用 buy + 物 + for + 人。

quiz.question: Ella sent a photo ___ her cousin.
quiz.hint: send 的收件人放在物品後面時，以 to 連接。

quiz.question: Dad cooked vegetable soup ___ my sick sister.
quiz.hint: cook 表示替人準備食物，用 cook + 物 + for + 人。

quiz.question: The student showed his sore hand ___ the nurse.
quiz.hint: show 的物在前時，用 to 帶出看東西的人。

quiz.question: My sister made a birthday card ___ me.
quiz.hint: make 表示替人製作東西，用 make + 物 + for + 人。

quiz.question: Please pass that bottle of water ___ your uncle.
quiz.hint: pass + 物 + to + 人表示把物品遞給某人。

quiz.question: Leo wrote a short letter ___ his sick friend.
quiz.hint: write + 信件 + to + 人表示寫信給收件人。

quiz.question: The doctor gave ___ some advice about sleep.
quiz.hint: give + 人 + 物中，人是受詞，she 要改為受格 her。

quiz.question: Grandpa bought ___ a warm scarf yesterday.
quiz.hint: buy + 人 + 物中，人是受詞，第一人稱用 me。

quiz.question: These are Ben's gloves. Please give ___ to him.
quiz.hint: gloves 是複數物品；give 後用受格 them 代替。

quiz.question: The soup is ready. Please bring it to ___.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後要接受格；he 的受格是 him。

quiz.question: Mom made ___ a sandwich before school.
quiz.hint: make + 人 + 物中，人須用受格 him。

quiz.question: I sent the message to ___ this morning.
quiz.hint: to 後接人稱代名詞的受格 them。

quiz.question: ___ did Eric leave the party? Because he felt sick.
quiz.hint: Because 帶出離開的原因，問原因用 Why。

quiz.question: Why ___ your sister so quiet today?
quiz.hint: quiet 是形容詞，問狀態用 be 動詞；your sister 搭配 is。

quiz.question: Why ___ the players tired after yesterday's game?
quiz.hint: yesterday 指過去，複數主詞 the players 的 be 動詞用 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ your dad wear a mask on the bus every day?
quiz.hint: 一般動詞 wear 的習慣性動作問句，單數主詞 your dad 用 does。

quiz.question: Why ___ you call the nurse last night?
quiz.hint: last night 指過去，動作 call 的問句用 did。

quiz.question: Why did Nina ___ her neck during class?
quiz.hint: did 後面的主要動詞用原形 touch。

quiz.question: Why didn't your brother ___ his coat to school?
quiz.hint: didn't 後面仍用原形動詞 wear。

quiz.question: Why does the baby ___ so much at night?
quiz.hint: does 後的主要動詞用原形 cry。

quiz.question: Why ___ you and your sister at the hospital yesterday?
quiz.hint: at the hospital 是狀態；過去時間、複數主詞用 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ your hands wet now?
quiz.hint: wet 是形容詞，現在狀態用 be 動詞；複數 hands 用 are。

quiz.question: Why did the teacher ___ your parents?
quiz.hint: Did 已表示過去，主要動詞 call 保持原形。

quiz.question: Why ___ Mia at home last Monday?
quiz.hint: at home 描述狀態；last Monday 指過去，Mia 搭配 was。

quiz.question: Lily drank warm water ___ her throat hurt.（選出表示原因的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: her throat hurt 是完整的原因子句，用 because 引導。

quiz.question: My arm hurt, ___ I stopped playing tennis.（選出表示結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 手臂痛是原因，停止打球是結果，用 so 連接結果。

quiz.question: ___ the child had a fever, his dad took him home.
quiz.hint: the child had a fever 是完整原因子句，句首用 Because。

quiz.question: The nurse was busy, ___ we waited outside.（選出表示結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 護士忙是原因，在外等候是結果，結果前用 so。

quiz.question: Because my toe hurt, ___ could not run fast.
quiz.hint: 句首已有 Because 引導原因，主要子句直接用 I，不再加 so。

quiz.question: The girl was hungry, so ___ ate some bread.
quiz.hint: so 已連接結果子句，後面直接接主詞 she。

quiz.question: We went home early ___ our baby was tired.（選出表示原因的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: our baby was tired 是原因子句，用 because。

quiz.question: ___ my stomach hurt, I did not finish lunch.
quiz.hint: my stomach hurt 有主詞及動詞，要用 Because 引導原因。

quiz.question: The doctor was away, ___ Dad called another hospital.（選出表示結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 醫生不在導致爸爸打去別家醫院，結果子句用 so。

quiz.question: Because the room was cold, ___ closed the window.
quiz.hint: Because 已表示因果關係，主要子句直接以 we 開頭。

quiz.question: Nina could not join the game ___ her sore shoulder.
quiz.hint: her sore shoulder 是名詞片語，表示原因用 because of。

quiz.question: Oscar stayed in bed ___ he felt weak.
quiz.hint: he felt weak 是完整原因子句，用 because。

quiz.question: The class ended early ___ the teacher's illness.
quiz.hint: the teacher's illness 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: ___ his bad cough, the singer could not sing.
quiz.hint: his bad cough 是名詞片語，用 Because of 引導原因。

quiz.question: The boy cried ___ his ear hurt.
quiz.hint: his ear hurt 是完整子句，因此前面用 because。

quiz.question: We changed our plans ___ the storm.
quiz.hint: the storm 是名詞，表示原因要用 because of。

quiz.question: My sister could not talk much because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後需要完整子句，her throat was sore 有主詞和動詞。

quiz.question: Dad drove me to school because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 my sore leg，不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: The nurse sat down because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句 she felt tired，其餘選項都是名詞片語。

quiz.question: The trip was canceled because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 the heavy snow。

quiz.question: ___ did your grandma go to bed early? Because she had a headache.
quiz.hint: 回答說明提早睡覺的原因，所以用 Why 問原因。

quiz.question: Why didn't Leo ___ the doctor's message?
quiz.hint: didn't 後接原形 read，不加 to 或其他詞尾。

quiz.question: These masks are for the children. Please pass them ___ the children.
quiz.hint: pass + 物 + to + 人表示把物品遞給某人。

quiz.question: That scarf is for Amy. I made it ___ her.
quiz.hint: make + 物 + for + 人表示為某人製作物品。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個小女孩為什麼開始哭？

grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸買了一些蘋果給我們的鄰居。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的耳朵痛，所以我打電話給媽媽。

grammar.sentence: Because the baby was sick, we stayed inside.

grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩為什麼沒有吃完午餐？

grammar.sentence: Please pass that clean towel to her.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把那條乾淨的毛巾遞給她。

grammar.sentence: The singer rested because her throat hurt.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位歌手因為喉嚨痛而休息。

grammar.sentence: I wrote a letter to my grandma.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我寫了一封信給奶奶。

grammar.sentence: Why were your shoes wet this morning?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你的鞋子今天早上為什麼是濕的？

grammar.sentence: The children stayed inside because of the storm.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們因為暴風雨而待在室內。

grammar.sentence: My aunt gave us some fresh fruit.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我阿姨給我們一些新鮮水果。

grammar.sentence: Why did your father call the school?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你爸爸為什麼打電話到學校？

grammar.sentence: Because my neck hurt, I took a break.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為我的脖子痛，所以我休息了一下。

grammar.sentence: The soup is ready, so please sit down.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 湯準備好了，所以請坐下。

grammar.sentence: We bought a warm coat for Grandpa.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們買了一件暖和的大衣給爺爺。

grammar.sentence: Why does your shoulder hurt every morning?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你的肩膀為什麼每天早上都會痛？

grammar.sentence: She missed the concert because of her fever.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她因為發燒而錯過演唱會。

grammar.sentence: Please send the class photo to him.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把班級照片傳給他。

grammar.sentence: I wore gloves because my hands were cold.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為我的手很冷，所以我戴上手套。

grammar.sentence: Why didn't your sister answer my message?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你姊姊為什麼沒有回覆我的訊息？
